interface.evidence: Original problem lists these six single-bit ports.

semantics.function: Both outputs select b exactly when both selectors are true; otherwise select a.
semantics.implementation: out_assign uses continuous assign; out_always uses a procedural if/else.
semantics.timing: Combinational, no clock, no added cycle latency or stored state; sample after combinational settling.
semantics.reset_initialization: No clock, reset, or initialization requirements appear in the original interface or behavior; no such ports or state are added.

numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow applies.

verification.oracle: Truth table independently expressed by selector case: 00,01,10 select a; 11 selects b.
verification.coverage: All 16 binary input combinations, then reverse traversal to check changes and lack of retained state.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs and wait one simulation time unit before comparing both outputs with case inequality.
verification.success: Fatal on any mismatch; bounded timeout; PASS printed only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: X/Z input behavior is unspecified. Binary functional coverage is required; standard SystemVerilog conditional and procedural-if semantics apply outside binary inputs without an added behavioral requirement.
